info.name: SPVDirect API
info.description:
All SPVDirect backend endpoints, with Postman tests. Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner (in order) against a running backend (`npm run dev` in `backend/`).

Setup: the dev server uses HTTPS with a self-signed certificate (`npm run cert:dev`), so turn off *Settings → SSL certificate verification* in Postman. Cookies (`spv_session`, `spv_anaf_oauth`) are kept by Postman's cookie jar for `localhost`.

Variables: `baseUrl`, `email`, `password`, `cui` (a real CUI; creating a company looks it up at ANAF). `accountantId`, `companyId`, `connectionId` and `linkToken` are filled in by the test scripts.

Safety: the run deletes only a company it created itself (`companyCreatedByRun`). *Delete connection* revokes the certificate's tokens at ANAF, so it is skipped unless you set `allowConnectionDelete` to `true`. Requests that need an ANAF connection are skipped until one exists: connect a certificate in the browser (`/accountants/:accountantId/anaf/connect`) and run again.

Register and Login are throttled to 10 requests per minute; creating or refreshing a company to 20 per minute.

request.description: Public. Returns `{ "status": "ok" }`.

request.description: Throttled (20/min). CUI may include `RO` and spaces; it is stored as digits (2-10). Name and details come from the ANAF VAT registry. 409 if the CUI already exists for this accountant (the test then picks the existing company). 400 if ANAF does not know the CUI, 502 if ANAF is unreachable. Saves `companyId`.
